title: Birdwatching for beginners: what you need, where to go and how to make it count

posts.facebook:
A free app, a spot to stand and twenty minutes at sunrise. Birdwatching starts wherever you already are.

A beginner's guide to birdwatching: the free apps that identify birds for you, when binoculars are worth having, the honest challenges, the big public counts you can join, and guided walks and reserves near you.

Learn the dozen birds nearest your door first. Everything else is built on knowing what is ordinary.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/explore/birdwatching-for-beginners/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
